description: Clean a lead CSV: malformed, duplicate, role-based (info@, sales@) and disposable addresses removed, with a count for each reason. Returns the cleaned CSV when it is 500 rows or fewer; a larger file is summarised and the person is sent to the page to download the full result. Does not verify mailboxes exist.

csv.description: The lead CSV as text, header row first, with an email column.

removeDisposable.description: Remove disposable-domain addresses. Defaults to true.

removeRole.description: Remove role addresses. Defaults to true.

name: clean_csv
title: Lead CSV cleaner
